title: Evaluating the Promise and Pitfalls of LLMs in Hiring Decisions

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating and comparing the Scoring Rate (SR) and Impact Ratio (IR) of model-generated hiring suitability scores across self-reported male and female candidate groups using the EEOC's four-fifths rule.

Calculating and comparing the Scoring Rate (SR) and Impact Ratio (IR) of model-generated hiring suitability scores across self-reported racial and ethnic groups (e.g., Asian, Black, Hispanic, White) using the EEOC's four-fifths rule.

Evaluating disparate impact by computing scoring rates and impact ratios for subgroups defined by the combination of race and gender (e.g., Asian Female, Hispanic Male) to identify compounding biases.
